page_title: EMP 2-1 ROM | Empoli v AS Roma 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! M'Baye Niang (Empoli) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' Joao Costa (AS Roma) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
88' Substitution. Paulo Dybala leaves the pitch and is replaced by Joao Costa (AS Roma).
88' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
87' A corner kick by Empoli is thwarted by the well prepared Mile Svilar (AS Roma).
87' A lofted cross from Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
85' A goal, which was scored by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma), was disallowed due to offside.
84' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
82' It will be a corner kick for AS Roma.
81' This is a yellow card! Razvan Marin (Empoli) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
79' Daniele De Rossi prepares a substitution. Nicola Zalewski is replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
78' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
77' It's time for a substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) comes on in place of Youssef Maleh.
76' Half-chance! Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) plays a pass into the box, but Elia Caprile reacts well to snuff out the attack.
73' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
72' The ball is behind the sideline. Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) takes a throw-in.
70' A first-time shot by Razvan Marin (Empoli) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
70' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) replacing Houssem Aouar.
70' Substitution. Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) on for Tammy Abraham.
69' Razvan Marin (Empoli) tries his luck with a long-range shot, but the ball crashes against the bar. Great effort!
68' Empoli fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.
67' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Bartosz Bereszynski and he is replaced by Francesco Caputo (Empoli).
66' The resulting set piece from Empoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

66' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
62' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
60' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

59' What a wasted opportunity by Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top of the net, but Mile Svilar makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
57' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) comes onto the pitch for Simone Bastoni.
54' Golden chance! M'Baye Niang (Empoli) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
53' AS Roma have a corner.
53' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.

52' Well-positioned Liberato Cacace (Empoli) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
49' The ball is out of play and AS Roma manage to earn a corner.
48' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
46' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
46' The game is over for Mattia Destro. M'Baye Niang (Empoli) comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Davide Nicola probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Emmanuel Gyasi. He is replaced by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' 1 - 1 Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Elia Caprile intercepts the ball.
43' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
41' Mattia Destro (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

41' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar pulls off a brilliant save.
39' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
38' High and wide! Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
37' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
34' The game is interrupted now, Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' The referee is firm and issues Mattia Destro (Empoli) a deserved yellow card.
32' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
31' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
30' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Mile Svilar pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
27' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
27' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) picks up a long through ball, but Mile Svilar deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
26' Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Empoli have a free kick.
24' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
22' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Davide Massa blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli will take a free kick.
22' Angelino (AS Roma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
21' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for AS Roma due to an offside in the build-up play.
20' Wait! Referee Davide Massa has indicated he is going to review the AS Roma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
19' Goal! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:1.
18' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Empoli is cautioned for aggressive play. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
17' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
16' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
15' Elia Caprile (Empoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
13' 1 - 0 Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) collects a killer pass inside the box that puts him one-on-one against the goalkeeper. He scores, drilling a low drive deep inside the left post!
11' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Liberato Cacace (Empoli) but poses no threat.
10' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
9' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
8' Empoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
6' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
5' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
3' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
2' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
1' The match has just started.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Davide Massa will supervise the game today.
